title: SAP Datasphere
description:
Job Summary
  
Project Manager for an MNC responsible for planning coordinating and delivering SAP Datasphere projects in a hybrid work model focusing on replication flows data flows and data modelling for cheminformatics and bioinformatics programs ensuring high quality outcomes and collaboration across global scientific and data teams.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Manage end to end delivery of SAP Datasphere initiatives ensuring replication flow data flow and data modelling workstreams are executed on time within scope and aligned to stakeholder expectations in cheminformatics and bioinformatics domains.
  
Coordinate detailed project plans for SAP Datasphere replication flow and data flow pipelines defining milestones dependencies and resource needs to support scientific data integration and analytics.
  
Monitor project progress using structured status tracking proactively identifying schedule risks in data modelling or integration tasks and driving timely mitigation actions with technical and domain experts.
  
Align project activities with hybrid work model practices balancing on site collaboration for critical design workshops with remote execution to maintain efficiency and work life balance.
  
Collaborate closely with data architects SAP specialists and scientific users to translate cheminformatics and bioinformatics requirements into actionable SAP Datasphere configurations and project deliverables.
  
Support project governance by organizing review meetings preparing concise progress reports and maintaining transparent communication with sponsors on scope budget and quality aspects.
  
Ensure data quality and consistency by coordinating validation activities for replication flows data flows and models that support research datasets and experimental results.
  
Partner with domain scientists to prioritize backlog items ensuring that data platform enhancements directly enable discovery predictive modelling and advanced analytics in chemistry and biology research.
  
Coordinate with enterprise IT and security teams to align SAP Datasphere solutions with organizational standards on access control compliance and responsible data use in scientific contexts.
  
Drive issue resolution by facilitating root cause analysis sessions for problems in data flows or models and coordinating action plans that restore stable operations for research users.
  
Support change management by planning user training sessions preparing reference materials and encouraging adoption of new data workflows among cheminformatics and bioinformatics stakeholders.
  
Optimize project execution by analyzing lessons learned from previous releases and applying improvements to estimation planning and collaboration practices in subsequent waves.
  
Communicate clearly with cross functional teams about priorities expectations and timelines ensuring that technical and scientific contributors remain synchronized throughout the project lifecycle.
  
Provide guidance on aligning SAP Datasphere capabilities with long term data platform strategies emphasizing sustainable architecture that can scale with future research and analytics demands.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Require professional experience of six to eight years in project management with at least three years handling SAP data platform or analytics projects in complex enterprise environments.
  
Require hands on exposure to SAP Datasphere replication flow data flow and data modelling activities sufficient to plan tasks estimate effort and engage meaningfully with technical practitioners.
  
Require demonstrated experience managing projects in cheminformatics or bioinformatics domains supporting scientific data pipelines research workflows or computational analysis initiatives.
  
Require strong understanding of how scientific data such as chemical structures assay results and biological sequences are curated transformed and integrated into analytics ready datasets.
  
Require proven ability to manage stakeholders from both technical and scientific backgrounds balancing competing priorities while maintaining focus on outcome driven delivery.
  
Require familiarity with hybrid work models including coordination of distributed teams use of collaboration tools and facilitation of remote workshops or standups.
  
Require solid knowledge of project management practices including scope management risk management schedule control and status reporting using recognized frameworks.
  
Nice to have exposure to agile or iterative delivery methods for data and analytics projects including backlog management and incremental release planning.
  
Nice to have understanding of cloud based data platforms and integration patterns that complement SAP Datasphere in enterprise research environments.
  
Nice to have experience working in multinational organizations where cross cultural communication and alignment across regions are part of daily responsibilities.
  
Nice to have familiarity with regulatory and compliance considerations related to scientific data such as data governance audit readiness and controlled access to sensitive datasets.
  
Nice to have professional certification in project management or data related disciplines that demonstrates commitment to continuous learning and structured delivery practices.
  
  

Certifications Required
  
Preferred certifications include PMP or PRINCE2 and SAP certified application associate in SAP Datasphere or similar SAP data and analytics certification.

description:
**Date posted** 09/22/2026
### **Category** **Information Technology****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **16685****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **09/22/2026**

### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years building and maintaining Windows infrastructure at scale, and you know the difference between a solution that works in a lab and one that survives 30,000 users across time zones with different workflows, security requirements, and legacy dependencies. You think in standards, not one\-offs. When someone asks for a quick fix, you see the pattern that will repeat 500 times next quarter and you build the architecture that prevents it.


You are equally comfortable deep in PowerShell debugging a provisioning failure and sitting with security and cloud teams translating compliance requirements into an endpoint configuration baseline that actually works. You do not wait for perfect documentation. You ask the right questions, map the dependencies, and design solutions that others can implement and maintain long after you move to the next problem.


You have strong opinions about patch rings, image standards, and automation workflows, and you know how to defend them without alienating the people who have to live with your decisions. At Synopsys, you will design the Windows infrastructure that powers how engineers build the technology inside every smart device on the planet.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design enterprise\-scale Windows Server and Endpoint architecture, including OS provisioning standards, configuration baselines, image builds, and lifecycle management across a global multi\-tenant environment
* Define and implement patch management strategy for Windows infrastructure, including patching rings, testing workflows, maintenance windows, emergency security patching processes, and exception handling
* Build automation for provisioning, configuration, patching, application deployment, compliance checks, and reporting using PowerShell, Python, and orchestration platforms
* Develop application packaging, testing, deployment, monitoring, and rollback processes that work across diverse business units and use cases
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud, Network, and Operations teams to ensure Windows solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, security requirements, and operational standards
* Lead migration strategies from traditional endpoint management platforms to modern management approaches, including zero\-touch and low\-touch provisioning models
* Create and maintain architecture documents, technical standards, implementation guides, HLD/LLD documentation, and runbooks that other teams can actually use

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Standardize Windows infrastructure across the enterprise, reducing configuration drift and cutting troubleshooting time for operations teams by defining repeatable, scalable patterns
* Accelerate OS deployment and upgrades across thousands of endpoints and servers by designing provisioning workflows that remove manual steps and human error
* Strengthen security posture by embedding hardening requirements, vulnerability remediation processes, and compliance controls directly into Windows architecture and automation
* Enable faster application delivery by building deployment pipelines that application teams can use without reinventing packaging and testing every time
* Reduce operational toil by converting repetitive manual tasks into automated workflows that free engineers to focus on higher\-value work
* Improve patch compliance and reduce risk by designing patch management architecture that balances speed, stability, and business continuity
* Support DevOps adoption across Windows infrastructure by promoting Infrastructure as Code, version control, automated testing, and repeatable deployments

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience managing enterprise Windows Server and Endpoint environments in multi\-tenant, large\-scale settings
* Deep technical expertise in Windows Server administration, troubleshooting, Active Directory, and endpoint management platforms
* Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills with the ability to build production\-grade scripts that others can maintain
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise patch management, application deployment, and OS provisioning solutions
* Ability to create architecture documentation including HLD, LLD, technical standards, and implementation guides that translate strategy into action
* Experience with Configuration Manager/SCCM, MDT, Windows Autopilot, Intune, or Tanium is highly desirable; exposure to REST APIs, Git/GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, or Infrastructure as Code concepts is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud, and Network engineers and walk out with a Windows architecture design that all of them can support without compromising their own requirements
* You see a patching failure pattern across 200 servers and immediately start building the automation and process changes that prevent it from happening again, not just fixing it manually each time
* You write PowerShell scripts that other engineers can read, modify, and trust six months later without needing you in the room to explain what it does
* You push back when a business requirement conflicts with scalability or security, and you offer an alternative that meets the need without creating technical debt downstream
* You treat documentation as a deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know that architecture only scales if other people can implement it without guessing
* You stay current on Windows management technologies and approaches, and you know when to adopt modern tooling versus when to optimize what already works

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.
